_how: Which pages are listed on the homepage, and how their tile looks. show: false hides a page (it still works by its link, it just isn't listed, and it is not named anywhere on the published site). icon: binder, route, bell, hat, book, train or coins (drawn in homepage/build.mjs). color: the tile, ink: text and lines on it.
